text:
Priya: Starting thread to finalize run-of-show for the May 12 webinar. Working title suggestion: 'Practical Inference: micro-demos + real-world cost patterns'. Proposed structure: 3 minute welcome, 18 minute keynote, three 5-minute micro-demos, 15 minute live Q&A. Need signoff on abstracts, demo owners, rehearsal windows, and backup assets.

Sasha: Sounds good. For landing page copy let's lead with a clear engineering takeaway (e.g., how to cut inference cost by 2-3x) and 3 bullets for what attendees will learn. I can draft the 1-sentence abstract + bullets.

Kevin: I'll take the keynote. Plan to cover smart routing, batching heuristics, and when to prefer quantized variants. 18 minutes should be enough.

Miguel: I can own the routing/fallback demo. Proposed demos: 1) KV-prefix cache (show cold vs warm), 2) routing and graceful fallback to a quantized variant, 3) quantization + batching tradeoffs.

Tara: I'll do demo 3 (quantization + batching). I have a short notebook and a pre-sampled chart showing p50/p95 latency vs token cost. 5 minutes tight but doable.

Priya: Sasha take demo 1 (cache). Kevin keynote + Miguel demo 2 + Tara demo 3.

Sasha: Will build a tiny harness: single prompt repeated to show cold->warm latency drop and a screenshot table. Keep slides minimal.

Miguel: For fallback demo I'll show primary large model, then throttle network/CPU in the harness to trigger routing to a cheaper, compatible model. Backup: 90s recorded clip hosted at https://drive.redwood/demo-fallback-90s.mp4.

Priya: All demos must include a pre-recorded clip and static fallback screenshot in case of live infra issues. Ops-bot, please reserve tech rehearsal slots.

ops-bot: Tech rehearsal reserved: May 10 09:00-10:00 PDT. Full dress dry-run: May 11 08:00-09:00 PDT. Calendar invites posted to #calendar.

Kevin: Draft run-of-show below, edit as needed:

```
00:00 - Welcome & agenda (Priya) 3m
03:00 - Keynote: Practical inference patterns (Kevin) 18m
21:00 - Demo 1: KV-prefix caching (Sasha) 5m
26:00 - Demo 2: Routing & graceful fallback (Miguel) 5m
31:00 - Demo 3: Quantization + batching (Tara) 5m
36:00 - Live Q&A / panel (all) 15m
51:00 - Close & CTAs (Priya) 2m
```

Priya: For rehearsals please join 10 minutes early. Tech rehearsal focuses on demo plumbing (access keys, model variants, network throttling). Dry-run will run the full show including slide handoffs.

Sasha: Action items: draft 1-line landing abstract + three bullets, 1-slide demo deck, sample prompts. ETA: Apr 29 EOD.

Kevin: I'll upload the keynote deck (10 slides) and a short benchmark slide. ETA: Apr 30.

Miguel: Will prepare routing script, golden metrics screenshot (p50/p95 + cost delta) and the backup 90s video. ETA: Apr 30.

Tara: Will attach quantization notebook and pre-sampled chart. ETA: Apr 30.

Priya: Content checklist for marketing: one-sentence abstract + 3 bullets, 1-line bios for each speaker, demo repo link, signup CTA. Please drop all artifacts into https://drive.redwood/webinar-practical-inference/ by May 1.

Kevin: Prompt suggestions for demo 2 (routing): use prompts with varying sequence lengths so routing heuristics trigger. Examples: "Summarize this 1200-word policy into 3 bullets" and "Write a concise reply to a long customer billing thread".

Sasha: Caching demo prompts will reuse the same user query multiple times to illustrate cold vs warm cache. Example prompt: "Explain KV caching for real-time chat and show perf".

Miguel: Contingency plan if live demos fail: 1) switch to pre-recorded clip, 2) show static screenshots and narrate outcomes, 3) offer follow-up with logs and code. Hosts should have a 2-line fallback script ready.

Priya: Who will moderate chat/lead routing during the live event? Recommend marketing-ops + a Solutions SE. Miguel can own follow-ups; Tara can triage technical questions.

Miguel: Will monitor live chat and capture leads.

Tara: I'll triage technical chat and escalate when needed.

Priya: Final: unless objections, locking the run-of-show and rehearsal times by EOD today. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:

Sasha: SGTM :thumbsup:

Kevin: All good from my side.

Miguel: Ready.

Tara: Ready.

Priya: I'll post the locked run-of-show and the marketing deadline reminders.

Sasha: Dropping my 1-line bio and landing abstract in this thread now.

Kevin: Dropping a 1-line bio and will add to slide footers.
